JARVIS v0.5.8

本次更新修正語音輸入的一個問題。

修正
- 房間安靜或只有背景聲時，語音輸入不再把「[BLANK_AUDIO]」、「(music)」等標記當作你說的話。這類輸入現在會直接略過，不會儲存為訊息，亦不會交給 AI 回覆。

適用於 Apple Silicon Mac，App 要求 macOS 12 或以上。
notes_en:
JARVIS v0.5.8

This update fixes a problem with voice input.

Fixes
- When the room is quiet or there is only background sound, voice input no longer treats markers such as "[BLANK_AUDIO]" or "(music)" as something you said. That input is now skipped: it is not saved as a message and not sent to the AI.

For Apple Silicon Macs; the app requires macOS 12 or later.
